about: Held-out evaluation set for cad_agent. Never tune on these; report results only. Each request comes with the user's L1 requirements (atomic, measurable where possible) and the verification method we expect for each. Tiers: 1 easy (1-2 parts, every size stated) .. 5 very hard (needs features, analyses or mechanisms the current shape library lacks). 'beyond_library' lists what the current system cannot represent yet, so a failure there maps the frontier rather than a bug.

methods.inspection: read from the design or mesh (counts, sizes, positions, relations)
methods.analysis: computed by Python (stability, connectivity, hand calculations, FEA, modal)
methods.demonstration: a stand-in object is placed in the design (fits, rests, does not slide)
methods.test: a probe is applied (insert, drop, load path)

requests.title: name plate
requests.request: A desk name plate: a 100 x 20 x 5 mm base with a 100 mm wide, 40 mm tall, 3 mm thick plate standing upright along its back edge.

l1.text: The base shall be 100 x 20 x 5 mm.
The plate shall be 100 mm wide, 40 mm tall and 3 mm thick.
The plate shall stand vertically on top of the base along its back edge.
The name plate shall stand on a desk without tipping.

requests.title: round coaster
requests.request: A plain round coaster 90 mm across and 4 mm thick.

l1.text: The coaster shall be a single round disc 90 mm in diameter.
The coaster shall be 4 mm thick.

requests.title: pen cup
requests.request: A pen cup: a round tube 80 mm across and 100 mm tall standing on a round base 90 mm across and 5 mm thick.

l1.text: The base shall be a round disc 90 mm across and 5 mm thick.
The cup shall be a hollow tube 80 mm across and 100 mm tall, open at the top.
The cup shall stand centred on top of the base.
A pen 10 mm across shall fit inside the cup and reach the base.

requests.title: door wedge
requests.request: A door wedge 120 mm long and 40 mm wide that rises from nothing to 25 mm at one end.

l1.text: The wedge shall be a single triangular prism 120 mm long and 40 mm wide.
The wedge shall rise from 0 mm to 25 mm along its length.
The wedge shall rest on its flat bottom face.

requests.title: monitor riser
requests.request: A monitor riser: a 400 x 200 x 15 mm board on two 60 mm tall supports, one under each end.

l1.text: The top board shall be 400 x 200 x 15 mm.
There shall be exactly two supports, one under each end of the board.
The top of the board shall be 75 mm above the desk.
The riser shall stand without tipping.

requests.title: shelf peg
requests.request: A shelf peg: a rod 6 mm across and 40 mm long with a round head 12 mm across and 3 mm thick on one end.

l1.text: The rod shall be 6 mm in diameter and 40 mm long.
The head shall be a disc 12 mm in diameter and 3 mm thick.
The head shall be centred on one end of the rod, on the rod's axis.

requests.title: book stand
requests.request: A book stand: a 200 x 150 x 8 mm base, a back support 180 mm tall leaning back at 75 degrees, and a 20 mm high lip along the front to hold the book.

l1.text: The base shall be 200 x 150 x 8 mm.
The back support shall be 180 mm tall and lean back at 75 degrees from horizontal.
A front lip 20 mm high shall run along the front edge of the base.
A book 30 mm thick shall rest between the lip and the back support.
The stand shall not tip with the book resting on it.

requests.title: small bench
requests.request: A small bench: a 400 x 150 x 20 mm seat on two side panels 300 mm tall that run the full depth of the seat.

l1.text: The seat shall be 400 x 150 x 20 mm.
There shall be two side panels, one under each end of the seat.
Each side panel shall be 300 mm tall and 150 mm deep.
The bench shall stand without tipping.

requests.title: sign holder
requests.request: A sign holder: a 120 x 60 x 6 mm base with a 120 x 100 x 3 mm upright panel across the middle, braced by a triangular gusset at each end behind it.

l1.text: The base shall be 120 x 60 x 6 mm.
The upright panel shall be 120 mm wide, 100 mm tall and 3 mm thick.
The panel shall stand vertically across the middle of the base, front to back.
Two triangular gussets shall brace the back of the panel to the base, one at each end.
All parts shall form one connected body.

requests.title: remote caddy
requests.request: A remote control caddy: a 160 x 100 x 4 mm floor with 50 mm tall, 3 mm thick walls on all four sides.

l1.text: The floor shall be 160 x 100 x 4 mm.
Walls shall enclose all four sides of the floor.
Each wall shall be 50 mm tall and 3 mm thick and rise above the floor.
A remote 40 x 20 x 150 mm shall fit inside standing on its end.

requests.title: cable peg rack
requests.request: A cable organiser: a 150 x 40 x 5 mm base with five round pegs 8 mm across and 30 mm tall evenly spaced in a row along it.

l1.text: The base shall be 150 x 40 x 5 mm.
There shall be exactly five pegs, each 8 mm across and 30 mm tall.
The pegs shall stand upright on the base, evenly spaced in one row along its length.
A 6 mm cable shall fit between neighbouring pegs.

requests.title: three-legged stool
requests.request: A three-legged stool: a round seat 250 mm across and 18 mm thick on three round legs 25 mm across and 350 mm tall.

l1.text: The seat shall be a round disc 250 mm across and 18 mm thick.
There shall be exactly three legs, each 25 mm across and 350 mm tall.
The legs shall be under the seat, spread in a triangle and inside the seat's outline.
The stool shall stand without tipping.

requests.title: phone stand by function
requests.request: A phone stand for a phone 75 mm wide and 9 mm thick that holds it at about 60 degrees for watching videos.

l1.text: The stand shall hold a 75 x 150 x 9 mm phone at 60 +/- 5 degrees from horizontal.
The phone shall not slide off the front of the stand.
The stand with the phone on it shall not tip over.
The stand shall be no wider than 100 mm.

beyond_library: sizes must be derived from the stand-in object, none are given

requests.title: headphone stand
requests.request: A headphone stand: a round base 130 mm across, a vertical post 260 mm tall rising from its centre, and a 90 mm wide cradle bar across the top of the post for the headband.

l1.text: The base shall be round, 130 mm across.
The post shall rise vertically from the centre of the base.
The top of the cradle bar shall be 260 mm or more above the desk.
The cradle bar shall be 90 mm wide and sit on top of the post, centred.
The stand shall not tip with 300 g hanging from the bar.

requests.title: spice rack
requests.request: A two-tier spice rack 300 mm wide and 100 mm deep: a bottom board, a second shelf 120 mm above it, and side panels at both ends holding the shelves.

l1.text: The rack shall be 300 mm wide and 100 mm deep overall.
There shall be a bottom board and one shelf 120 mm above it.
Side panels at both ends shall support both shelves.
A spice jar 45 mm across and 100 mm tall shall fit on the bottom board under the shelf.
All parts shall form one connected body.

beyond_library: a part attached to two parents (shelf between both side panels)

requests.title: laptop riser by function
requests.request: A laptop riser that lifts the back of a 15-inch laptop by 50 mm while its front edge stays on the desk.

l1.text: The riser shall support a 360 x 250 mm laptop with its back edge 50 +/- 5 mm above the desk.
The laptop's front edge shall rest on the desk.
The laptop shall not slide down the riser.
The riser shall be no deeper than 250 mm.

beyond_library: sizes must be derived from the stand-in object, none are given

requests.title: plant stand with lower shelf
requests.request: A plant stand: a 250 x 250 x 15 mm top on four 30 mm square legs 400 mm tall, with a lower shelf halfway down joining the legs.

l1.text: The top shall be 250 x 250 x 15 mm.
There shall be four 30 mm square legs, one near each corner, 400 mm tall.
A lower shelf shall join all four legs at half their height.
The stand shall not tip with a 3 kg pot centred on the top.

beyond_library: a part attached to several parents (shelf between four legs)

requests.title: bookend by function
requests.request: An L-shaped bookend that holds up books 250 mm tall without sliding.

l1.text: The upright shall be tall enough to support books 250 mm tall at least halfway up (125 mm or more).
The base shall extend under the books so their weight keeps the bookend in place.
The upright shall be perpendicular to the base.
The bookend shall not tip over when a 1 kg row of books leans on it.

beyond_library: sizes must be derived from function, few are given

requests.title: desk organiser with compartments
requests.request: A desk organiser: a 200 x 120 x 5 mm base with a tray divided into three equal compartments by 40 mm tall walls, plus a round pen cup 60 mm across in the back right corner.

l1.text: The base shall be 200 x 120 x 5 mm.
Walls 40 mm tall shall enclose a tray divided into three equal compartments.
A round pen cup 60 mm across shall stand in the back right corner.
The pen cup and the tray shall not overlap.

beyond_library: dividers placed at fractions of a span
a part placed relative to another part's corner

requests.title: wall hook rack
requests.request: A wall hook rack: a 300 x 80 x 10 mm back board with four hooks angled 30 degrees upward, evenly spaced along it.

l1.text: The back board shall be 300 x 80 x 10 mm and stand vertically.
There shall be exactly four hooks, evenly spaced along the board.
Each hook shall point forward and up at 30 degrees from horizontal.
Each hook shall hold a 1 kg coat without bending more than 2 mm.

beyond_library: angled rods (cylinder at an arbitrary angle)

requests.title: table with aprons
requests.request: A small table: a 600 x 400 x 20 mm top on four 40 mm square legs 450 mm tall, set in 30 mm from the edges, with 60 mm tall apron rails joining the legs just under the top.

l1.text: The top shall be 600 x 400 x 20 mm.
There shall be four 40 mm square legs, 450 mm tall, each inset 30 mm from both edges.
Apron rails 60 mm tall shall join neighbouring legs directly under the top on all four sides.
The table shall not tip with 10 kg placed on one corner of the top.

beyond_library: parts spanning between two other parts

requests.title: two-step stool
requests.request: A two-step stool 400 mm wide: a lower step 150 mm high and 200 mm deep at the front, and an upper step 300 mm high and 200 mm deep behind it.

l1.text: The lower step surface shall be 150 mm above the floor and 200 mm deep.
The upper step surface shall be 300 mm above the floor, 200 mm deep and behind the lower step.
The stool shall be 400 mm wide.
The stool shall not tip when 100 kg stands on the front edge of the lower step.

requests.title: cable box with lid
requests.request: A cable management box 300 x 120 x 120 mm with a separate lid and a 40 mm wide slot in each end for the cables.

l1.text: The box shall be 300 x 120 x 120 mm on the outside with an open top.
Each end wall shall have a slot 40 mm wide.
A separate lid shall cover the top and sit on the box without falling in.
A power strip 250 x 50 x 40 mm shall fit inside.

requests.title: tablet stand with cable hole
requests.request: A tablet stand: 180 x 120 x 8 mm base, a support leaning back at 65 degrees and 140 mm tall, a 12 mm front ledge, and a 20 mm round hole through the support for the charging cable.

l1.text: The base shall be 180 x 120 x 8 mm.
The support shall lean back at 65 degrees and be 140 mm tall.
A 12 mm ledge shall run along the front edge of the base.
A 20 mm hole shall pass through the support near its bottom, centred left to right.
A tablet 250 x 170 x 8 mm shall rest against the support without tipping the stand.

requests.title: shelf bracket rated for load
requests.request: A shelf bracket for a 200 mm deep shelf that must carry 5 kg at the front edge when printed in PLA.

l1.text: The bracket shall support a shelf 200 mm deep.
With 5 kg at 200 mm from the wall, the front shall deflect less than 2 mm.
With 5 kg at 200 mm from the wall, the bracket shall have a safety factor of at least 2 against PLA failure, including the weaker layer direction.
The bracket shall mount flat against a wall.

requests.title: hinged box
requests.request: A small box 80 x 60 x 40 mm with a lid that hinges along the back edge.

l1.text: The box shall be 80 x 60 x 40 mm closed.
The lid shall rotate about a hinge along the back edge.
The lid shall open to at least 90 degrees without hitting the box.

requests.title: speaker stand resonance
requests.request: A desktop speaker stand 150 x 150 mm and 120 mm tall that lifts a 2 kg speaker without resonating below 100 Hz.

l1.text: The top shall be 150 x 150 mm and 120 mm above the desk.
The stand shall carry a 2 kg speaker without tipping.
With the speaker on it, the stand's first natural frequency shall be above 100 Hz.

requests.title: child chair
requests.request: A child's chair: seat 300 x 300 mm at 300 mm high, a backrest 250 mm tall leaning back 10 degrees, and four legs, strong enough for 40 kg.

l1.text: The seat shall be 300 x 300 mm with its top 300 mm above the floor.
The backrest shall rise 250 mm above the seat at the back, leaning back 10 degrees.
There shall be four legs, one near each corner of the seat.
The chair shall not tip when 40 kg sits on it or leans on the backrest.
The chair shall carry 40 kg with a safety factor of at least 3.

beyond_library: parts attached to two parents (backrest to seat and rear legs)

requests.title: stackable tray
requests.request: A stackable tray 200 x 150 x 30 mm whose bottom fits inside the top of an identical tray so they nest securely.

l1.text: Each tray shall be 200 x 150 x 30 mm.
Two identical trays shall stack with the upper one's bottom locating inside the lower one's walls.
Stacked trays shall not slide sideways more than 1 mm.

requests.title: cantilever desk shelf
requests.request: A clamp-on desk shelf that grips a desk edge 20 to 30 mm thick and holds a 300 x 200 mm shelf above the desk for a 3 kg monitor.

l1.text: The clamp shall fit desk edges from 20 to 30 mm thick.
The shelf shall be 300 x 200 mm and level.
With a 3 kg monitor centred on it, the shelf shall deflect less than 3 mm.
With the monitor, the clamp shall not slip off the desk.
